name: UGC 9992 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 9992, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc09992-hubble
story: UGC 9992 is a dwarf irregular galaxy, and Hubble photographed it to measure its distance from its brightest red giant stars, adding one more point to a three-dimensional map of our cosmic neighborhood.

claims.text: UGC 9992 is a dwarf irregular (dIrr) galaxy
Hubble program 13442 observed UGC 9992 to measure distances to nearby galaxies from the tip of the red giant branch
Program 13442 uses the distances to build three-dimensional maps of galaxies
